title: Synthetic two-parameter Q-learning recovery
current_best_explanation: No current global winner has been verified on this exact frozen input, split and scorer. A published dataset name or broad leaderboard lead is insufficient.
executed_endpoint: 24 independent synthetic agents, 240 trials each, chosen-only Q updates from Q=[0.5,0.5], softmax beta, no lapses/perseveration, reversal each 60 trials. Recover alpha and beta from observed choices/rewards; primary allowed-range-normalized MAE. No labeled training agents; hidden generating prior/ranges must not be supplied only to a reference.

existing_reference.name: Correctly specified deterministic multistart likelihood MLE
existing_reference.evidence: A: exact model fit and local parameter recovery, not published SOTA.
existing_reference.strength: Exact two-dimensional likelihood is preferable to an unnecessary learned surrogate.
problems: MLE optimizes likelihood, not expected absolute parameter error.
Finite-sample shrinkage can improve MAE without better mechanistic recovery.
The hidden generator distribution differs from declared fitting bounds; using it only in a reference is unfair.
existing_reference.verification_scope: Only the named locally audited reference/archived outputs, not every newer candidate or equal-budget/global optimality.

candidates.name: Exact-likelihood bounded quadrature posterior median
candidates.evidence: C: mathematical decision-theoretic proposed comparator, not a published benchmark winner.
candidates.information_match: Posterior componentwise medians target absolute error under a declared prior; use only common exposed bounds, not hidden generating priors. Verify quadrature convergence.

candidates.name: HSSM choice-only RL/custom likelihood
candidates.evidence: B: maintained Bayesian cognitive toolbox with real choice-only RL support.
candidates.information_match: Must instantiate exactly the chosen-only Q update and softmax policy, initial Q and bounds; standard RLDDM adds unobserved RT/decision dynamics.

candidates.name: BayesFlow 2 / sbi posterior estimator
candidates.evidence: B: current amortized inference tools; exact M04 result absent.
candidates.information_match: Needs additional simulations, prior and training budget; not the best first comparator when exact two-parameter likelihood is cheap.

candidates.name: Hybrid neural–cognitive models
candidates.evidence: B/C: current research on richer learning mechanisms.
candidates.information_match: Changes the specified generative model; richer mechanism does not imply better exact-parameter estimation.

candidates.name: DynaMEchs
candidates.evidence: D: exact-name searches did not identify a relevant current cognitive-model benchmark.
candidates.information_match: Legacy multibody simulator is not a parameter-recovery model.

recommended_next_comparator: Prospectively fixed exact-likelihood quadrature posterior medians with an openly specified prior on the common allowed bounds, compared with MLE and posterior mean; HSSM exact choice-only implementation as an independent crosscheck.
switching_assessment: ADD an objective-aligned reference, high priority, Tier C mathematical proposal plus Tier B tooling. Keep MLE because it answers fit quality. Do not claim the quadrature method is current SOTA or use the hidden generator prior. No need to substitute a large amortized model.
limitations: Synthetic custom slice; no official Wilson–Collins leaderboard.
Parameter MAE and in-sample log likelihood answer different questions.
Prior sensitivity and weak identifiability dominate rankings in small datasets.
HSSM current documentation may be newer than a pinned release; prospective implementation needs version and exact likelihood audit.
DynaMEchs identity/relevance unresolved; no fabricated paper or match.

evidence_tiers.A: Locally executed and audited on this frozen protocol; establishes a comparator result, not universal optimality.
evidence_tiers.B: Primary method/benchmark with relevant task evidence but an unmatched split, inputs, scorer or budget.
evidence_tiers.C: Author repository, preprint, mathematical proposal or adaptation requiring additional validation.
evidence_tiers.D: Unresolved access, unavailable artifacts or input mismatch precludes an executable recommendation.

execution_policy: Literature review only. No inference, fitting, new scores, checkpoint downloads, frozen protocol edits or result changes. Any new comparator requires a prospective amendment, frozen training-only selection and separate result records.
score_import_policy: No unmatched published numbers were imported into benchmark scores.
